verdict.rationale: Airbyte's API, Terraform provider, and PyAirbyte SDK allow programmatic, scriptable control over many connections/sources/syncs at once, and connectors can be built and orchestrated via Airflow-style pipelines, supporting bulk automation workflows. However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operation endpoint (e.g., batch trigger/sync/delete across many connections in one call), and the OpenAPI spec itself couldn't be probed. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints, evidence of bulk operations at scale (e.g., hundreds of connections triggered simultaneously), and independent confirmation of bulk-op reliability.
